events.title: Delicious Demo Update!
events.summary: Hello! Ed here with another update on Dungeons & Desserts. We've been very busy these past few months, and I'm so happy to finally share this one with you. Heads up: saves have moved to support Steam Cloud, so, if you played the demo, this update starts you on a fresh save. There's a lot of new stuff, so it's a great excuse to start again! events.title: Candy Crawler is now Dungeons & Desserts! New Name, Same Sweet Adventure
events.summary: Hey everyone!We've got some exciting news to share. Candy Crawler is now Dungeons & Desserts!Why the change?As development progressed, we realized the original name wasn't quite capturing what makes this game special. Dungeons & Desserts is a unique blend of roguelite dungeon crawling and cozy pastry shop management, and we wanted a name that immediately tells you that.What's new?Along with the new name, we've also updated our key art to better showcase the dual-genre gameplay.
